## Problem

What problem should discern solve? Describe its effect without prescribing the implementation.

## Who it affects

Which projects, stacks, or domains encounter the problem? Explain why it is broader than one local workflow.

## Smallest change

Select the first approach that can solve the problem, then explain the choice.

- [ ] Explain existing behavior in the documentation
- [ ] Use existing project configuration or a supported agent integration
- [ ] Extend a configuration or integration point
- [ ] Change core behavior

Why do the earlier approaches fall short?

## Proposed outcome

What should be true for a user after discern resolves this issue?

## Evidence and alternatives

Include examples, measurements, prior discussion, or approaches you considered.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I searched for an existing issue that covers this problem.
- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I understand contributor intake is inactive and am not submitting an implementation.
- [ ] I explained why the problem applies beyond one stack, domain, or workflow.
